objects:
CREATE TABLE alert_delivery_items (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  advisory_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  revision TEXT NOT NULL,
  delivered_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  PRIMARY KEY (user_id, advisory_id)
)

CREATE TABLE alert_digest_runs (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  slot TEXT NOT NULL,
  status TEXT NOT NULL CHECK (status IN ('sending','sent','empty','failed')),
  claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  completed_at INTEGER,
  attempts INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 1,
  item_count INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
  provider_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY(user_id,slot)
)

CREATE TABLE alert_optins (
  user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  consented_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  unsubscribe_token TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE
)

CREATE TABLE alert_preferences(user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,severity TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'critical',frequency TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'daily',updated_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
CREATE TABLE auth_rate_limits(key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,count INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE inventory_assets (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  environment_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_environments(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  asset_type TEXT NOT NULL,
  technology TEXT NOT NULL,
  version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_customers (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(user_id,name)
)

CREATE TABLE inventory_environments (
  id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  customer_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES inventory_customers(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
  name TEXT NOT NULL,
  kind TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT 'Production',
  created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,
  UNIQUE(user_id,customer_id,name)
)

CREATE TABLE lifecycle_preferences (
 user_id TEXT PRIMARY KEY REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 email_enabled INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 0,
 lead_days INTEGER NOT NULL DEFAULT 90,
 updated_at INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE lifecycle_watches (
 user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,
 id TEXT NOT NULL,
 product TEXT NOT NULL,
 slug TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 cycle TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 installed_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 custom_eol_date TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 custom_source_url TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
 created_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
 PRIMARY KEY(user_id,id)
)
CREATE TABLE login_challenges(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,email TEXT NOT NULL,token_hash TEXT NOT NULL,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,used_at INTEGER,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)

CREATE TABLE remediation_assignment_limits (
  key TEXT PRIMARY KEY,
  window_start INTEGER NOT NULL,
  count INTEGER NOT NULL
)

CREATE TABLE remediation_assignments (
  user_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  cve_id TEXT NOT NULL,
  assignee_email TEXT NOT NULL,
  assigned_by TEXT NOT NULL,
  state TEXT NOT NULL CHECK(state IN ('sending','sent','failed')),
  claimed_at INTEGER NOT NULL,
  last_sent_at INTEGER,
  provider_id TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',
  PRIMARY KEY(user_id,cve_id),
  FOREIGN KEY(user_id,cve_id) REFERENCES remediations(user_id,cve_id) ON DELETE CASCADE
)

CREATE TABLE remediations(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,cve_id TEXT NOT NULL,status TEXT NOT NULL,owner TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',due TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',notes TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',updated_at TEXT NOT NULL,PRIMARY KEY(user_id,cve_id))
CREATE TABLE sessions(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,token_hash TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,expires_at INTEGER NOT NULL,created_at INTEGER NOT NULL)
CREATE TABLE user_stack(user_id TEXT NOT NULL REFERENCES users(id) ON DELETE CASCADE,technology TEXT NOT NULL,product_version TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT '',PRIMARY KEY(user_id,technology))
CREATE TABLE users(id TEXT PRIMARY KEY,email TEXT NOT NULL UNIQUE,created_at TEXT NOT NULL DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP)
